checkAndSwitchMode().details: Call path: any caller -> TradingRouter.checkAndSwitchMode -> TradingRouter._checkAndSwitchMode.

constructor.details: Call path: deployment script -> TradingRouter.constructor -> TradingRouter._resetPoolWindows.

getTradingModeStatus().details: Call path: DApp/keeper -> TradingRouter.getTradingModeStatus -> InteractionPool/PriceOracle. Expired flow windows are represented as newly rolled windows without mutating contract state.

previewSellMob(address,uint256).details: Call path: DApp -> TradingRouter.previewSellMob -> PriceOracle.quoteMobToUsdt/MiningSystem/TradingRouter; Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

setDailyNcnRequirement(uint256).details: Call path: operator -> TradingRouter.setDailyNcnRequirement; zero disables the NCN sale qualification.

setFlowSwitchThresholds(uint256,uint256).details: Call path: operator -> TradingRouter.setFlowSwitchThresholds; values apply immediately to current windows.

setPairs(address,address).details: Call path: owner -> TradingRouter.setPairs -> TradingRouter._validatePair; thenPair.

setPriceRecoveryThresholds(uint256,uint2.details: Call path: operator -> TradingRouter.setPriceRecoveryThresholds; values apply immediately in Pair mode.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

getTradingModeStatus().notice: Returns every balance, threshold, and boolean currently used to decide a trading-mode switch.

mobSellAllowance(address).notice: Returns MÖB actually received, sold through the DApp, and still sellable.

ncnSellQualificationStatus(address).notice: Returns the current cumulative NCN qualification used by every MÖB sale.

recordMobReceived(address,uint256).notice: Records MÖB that an approved DApp payout contract has already transferred to a user wallet.

remainingMobSellAllowance(address).notice: Returns the remaining MÖB amount that the account may sell through the DApp.

setDailyNcnRequirement(uint256).notice: Sets the per-assessment-day cumulative NCN trading requirement in USDT smallest units.

setFlowSwitchThresholds(uint256,uint256).notice: Updates the pool-mode daily and seven-day outflow thresholds.

setOperator(address).notice: Sets the operator that may update trading-mode thresholds.

setPriceRecoveryThresholds(uint256,uint2.notice: Updates Pair-mode price recovery and price-drop recovery thresholds.
